description: Java class HonoSenderSampler for JMeter testing, implementing a sampler that sends messages via HonoSender, with thread lifecycle management and configurable properties.

classes.name: HonoSenderSampler
classes.description: A JMeter sampler class for sending messages through Hono, managing thread lifecycle, and configurable message properties.

methods.name: getWaitForReceiversAsInt
methods.description: Returns the number of receivers to wait for as an integer, defaulting to 0 if parsing fails.

methods.name: getWaitForReceivers
methods.description: Retrieves the wait-for-receivers property as a string.

methods.name: setWaitForReceivers
methods.description: Sets the wait-for-receivers property.

methods.name: getWaitForReceiversTimeoutAsInt
methods.description: Returns the timeout for waiting for receivers as an integer, defaulting to 0 if parsing fails.

methods.name: getWaitForReceiversTimeout
methods.description: Retrieves the wait-for-receivers timeout property as a string.

methods.name: setWaitForReceiversTimeout
methods.description: Sets the wait-for-receivers timeout property.

methods.name: getSendTimeoutOrDefaultAsInt
methods.description: Returns the send timeout in milliseconds as an integer, defaulting to DEFAULT_SEND_TIMEOUT if parsing fails.

methods.name: getSendTimeoutOrDefault
methods.description: Retrieves the send timeout as a string, defaulting to DEFAULT_SEND_TIMEOUT if empty.

methods.name: setSendTimeout
methods.description: Sets the send timeout property.

methods.name: getDeviceId
methods.description: Returns the device ID property.

methods.name: setDeviceId
methods.description: Sets the device ID property.

methods.name: isSetSenderTime
methods.description: Checks if sender time should be added to payload.

methods.name: setSetSenderTime
methods.description: Configures whether to add current timestamp in payload.

methods.name: isWaitForDeliveryResult
methods.description: Determines if the sampler waits for delivery result, default true.

methods.name: setWaitForDeliveryResult
methods.description: Sets whether to wait for delivery result.

methods.name: getMessageCountPerSamplerRun
methods.description: Returns the number of messages to send per sampler run.

methods.name: getMessageCountPerSamplerRunAsInt
methods.description: Returns the message count as an integer, defaulting to 1 if invalid.

methods.name: setMessageCountPerSamplerRun
methods.description: Sets the number of messages per sampler run.

methods.name: getContentType
methods.description: Returns the content type property.

methods.name: setContentType
methods.description: Sets the content type property.

methods.name: getData
methods.description: Returns the payload data.

methods.name: setData
methods.description: Sets the payload data.

methods.name: sample
methods.description: Performs a sample operation by sending messages via HonoSender, returning a SampleResult.

methods.name: threadStarted
methods.description: Initializes HonoSender, waits for receivers if needed, and starts the sender.

methods.name: threadFinished
methods.description: Closes HonoSender during thread shutdown.
